Name: Manual Mine Refresh
Author: a524rgy84e6
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
手动刷新矿洞是一个 SMAPI Mod，可以让你在鹈鹕镇矿井或沙漠洞穴内立即刷新矿洞，不需要反复进出矿洞，也不用等待游戏自然刷新。
Manual Mine Refresh is a SMAPI mod that lets you instantly refresh mines from inside the Mines or Skull Cavern, without leaving and re-entering the mine or waiting for the game to refresh it naturally.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the ManualMineRefresh folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod through its menu. The mod also includes a built-in config menu with F7.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Instantly refresh mines from inside the Mines or Skull Cavern.[/*]
[*]Three refresh modes:
[list]
[*]Current floor: refresh and return to the current floor entrance.[/*]
[*]Next floor: refresh and immediately enter the next floor.[/*]
[*]Ladder trigger: prepare the next floor, then trigger it when using the ladder.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Multiplayer support.[/*]
[*]Host-controlled refresh permission in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Prevents refreshing when another player is on the affected floor.[/*]
[*]HUD button and hotkeys.[/*]
[*]Built-in config menu with F7.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[*]Chinese and English support.[/*]
[*]Faster mine descent / quick floor progression with Next floor mode.[/*]
[/list]中文说明：
[list]
[*]可以在矿洞内手动立即刷新矿洞，不用反复进出矿洞，也不用等待游戏自然刷新。[/*]
[*]支持星露谷矿井和沙漠矿洞。[/*]
[*]支持单人和联机。[/*]
[*]支持三种模式：当前层刷新、立即进入下一层、下层梯子触发。[/*]
[*]联机时由房主指定唯一拥有刷新权限的玩家。[/*]
[*]如果有其他玩家在受影响的矿层，mod 会禁止刷新，避免影响队友。[/*]
[*]默认快捷键：F5 刷新，F6 切换模式，F7 打开配置。[/*]
[*]也可以作为快速下矿辅助使用，通过“立即进入下一层”模式快速推进层数。[/*]
[/list]Tips:
[list]
[*]Use current-floor refresh to quickly return to the floor entrance when you are in danger.[/*]
[*]Use next-floor mode to move down faster.[/*]
[*]Use ladder-trigger mode if you want to keep the current floor unchanged but prepare a refreshed next floor.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

Required:
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[/list]Optional:
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]Supported:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and SMAPI for making mods like this possible. [/color]
特别感谢星露谷 Mod 社区、SMAPI，以及帮忙测试联机功能的朋友们。
